module AdaptiveTokenizer

using Random
using Unicode

export AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, encode, decode

const SYNASTRY_ORBS = [0.189, 0.172, 0.366, 0.224, 0.096, 0.154, 0.249, -0.12, 0.227, 0.709, -0.138, 0.301, 0.203, 0.943, 0.45, 0.265, 0.156, 0.147]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_1 = [25.925, 19.023, 15.506, 23.544, 26.571, 8.295, 24.611, 1.757, 12.946, 19.794]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_2 = [10.877, 18.723, 29.018, 27.266, 21.858, 1.237, 24.090, 20.250, 6.432, 14.681]
const EPSILON_THRESHOLD = 1.0e-14
const LORENZ_SIGMA = 10.0
const LORENZ_RHO = 28.0
const LORENZ_BETA = 2.6666666666666665
const LORENZ_DT = 0.01
const LORENZ_SCALE = 0.1

mutable struct AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer
    d_model::Int
    grid_size::Int
    degree::Int
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    reverse_vocab::Dict{Int, String}
    spline_coeffs::Vector{Float64}
    knot_vector::Vector{Float64}
    lorenz_buffer::Vector{Float64}
    
    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=4)
        if grid_size <= 0
            throw(ArgumentError("grid_size must be positive"))
        end
        if degree < 0 || degree >= grid_size
            throw(ArgumentError("degree must satisfy 0 <= degree < grid_size"))
        end
        if d_model <= 0
            throw(ArgumentError("d_model must be positive and reasonable"))
        end
        
        initial_vocab_size = 4 + 95
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}()
        sizehint!(vocab, initial_vocab_size)
        
        vocab["UNK"] = 0
        vocab["PAD"] = 1
        vocab["BOS"] = 2
        vocab["EOS"] = 3
        
        for i in 32:126
            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end
        
        reverse_vocab = Dict{Int, String}()
        sizehint!(reverse_vocab, length(vocab))
        for (k, v) in vocab
            reverse_vocab[v] = k
        end
        
        interior_count = grid_size - degree + 1
        interior_knots = collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=interior_count))
        knot_vector = vcat(zeros(Float64, degree), interior_knots, ones(Float64, degree))
        
        spline_coeffs = zeros(Float64, grid_size)
        lorenz_buffer = Vector{Float64}(undef, d_model)
        
        new(d_model, grid_size, degree, vocab, reverse_vocab, spline_coeffs, knot_vector, lorenz_buffer)
    end
end

function _lorenz_embedding!(destination::Vector{Float64}, token_id::Float64, token_position::Float64, embedding_dimension::Int)::Nothing
    x_state = token_id * LORENZ_SCALE
    y_state = token_position * 2.0
    z_state = token_id * 0.05
    
    @inbounds @simd for dimension_index in 1:embedding_dimension
        x_derivative = LORENZ_SIGMA * (y_state - x_state)
        y_derivative = x_state * (LORENZ_RHO - z_state) - y_state
        z_derivative = x_state * y_state - LORENZ_BETA * z_state
        
        x_state = muladd(x_derivative, LORENZ_DT, x_state)
        y_state = muladd(y_derivative, LORENZ_DT, y_state)
        z_state = muladd(z_derivative, LORENZ_DT, z_state)
        
        destination[dimension_index] = muladd(LORENZ_SCALE, sin(x_state), muladd(LORENZ_SCALE, cos(y_state), LORENZ_SCALE * sin(z_state)))
    end
    
    return nothing
end

function _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point::Float64, knot_vector::Vector{Float64}, basis_index::Int, basis_degree::Int)::Float64
    knot_length = length(knot_vector)
    
    if basis_index < 1 || basis_index + basis_degree >= knot_length
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_degree == 0
        lower_knot = knot_vector[basis_index]
        upper_knot = knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
        
        in_interval = (lower_knot <= evaluation_point && evaluation_point < upper_knot)
        at_endpoint = (abs(evaluation_point - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD && abs(upper_knot - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD)
        
        return (in_interval || at_endpoint) ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end
    
    result = 0.0
    
    coefficient_lower = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree] - knot_vector[basis_index]
    if abs(coefficient_lower) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_lower = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index, basis_degree - 1)
        result = muladd((evaluation_point - knot_vector[basis_index]) / coefficient_lower, recursive_lower, result)
    end
    
    coefficient_upper = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
    if abs(coefficient_upper) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_upper = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index + 1, basis_degree - 1)
        result = muladd((knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - evaluation_point) / coefficient_upper, recursive_upper, result)
    end
    
    return result
end

function _kan_spline_eval(normalized_position::Float64, spline_coefficients::Vector{Float64}, knot_sequence::Vector{Float64}, grid_dimension::Int, polynomial_degree::Int)::Float64
    if normalized_position < -EPSILON_THRESHOLD || normalized_position > 1.0 + EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        return 0.0
    end
    
    clamped_position = clamp(normalized_position, 0.0, 1.0)
    accumulated_value = 0.0
    
    @inbounds @simd for basis_index in 1:grid_dimension
        basis_contribution = _b_spline_basis(clamped_position, knot_sequence, basis_index, polynomial_degree)
        accumulated_value = muladd(spline_coefficients[basis_index], basis_contribution, accumulated_value)
    end
    
    return accumulated_value
end

function encode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, input_text::String, natal_chart::Vector{Float64})::Tuple{Vector{Int}, Matrix{Float64}}
    preprocessed_text = lowercase(replace(input_text, r"\s+" => " "))
    grapheme_sequence = collect(Unicode.graphemes(preprocessed_text))
    
    sequence_length = length(grapheme_sequence)
    
    if sequence_length == 0
        return (Int[], zeros(Float64, 0, tokenizer.d_model))
    end
    
    token_ids = Vector{Int}(undef, sequence_length)
    
    @inbounds for position in 1:sequence_length
        grapheme_item = grapheme_sequence[position]
        token_ids[position] = get(tokenizer.vocab, grapheme_item, 0)
    end
    
    embedding_matrix = Matrix{Float64}(undef, sequence_length, tokenizer.d_model)
    
    randn!(tokenizer.spline_coeffs)
    
    natal_chart_length = length(natal_chart)
    position_denominator = sequence_length > 1 ? Float64(sequence_length - 1) : 1.0
    
    synastry_length = length(SYNASTRY_ORBS)
    chart1_length = length(CELESTIAL_CHART_1)
    chart2_length = length(CELESTIAL_CHART_2)
    
    @inbounds for token_position in 1:sequence_length
        token_id_value = token_ids[token_position]
        token_id_f64 = Float64(token_id_value)
        position_f64 = Float64(token_position)
        
        _lorenz_embedding!(tokenizer.lorenz_buffer, token_id_f64, position_f64, tokenizer.d_model)
        
        weight_primary = muladd(sin(token_id_f64 * LORENZ_SCALE), 0.5, 0.5)
        
        chart1_idx = mod1(token_id_value, chart1_length)
        chart2_idx = mod1(token_position, chart2_length)
        
        celestial_degree = muladd(CELESTIAL_CHART_1[chart1_idx], weight_primary, CELESTIAL_CHART_2[chart2_idx] * (1.0 - weight_primary))
        phase_angle = sin(muladd(position_f64, LORENZ_SCALE, deg2rad(celestial_degree)))
        
        @inbounds @simd for dimension in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            tokenizer.lorenz_buffer[dimension] += phase_angle
        end
        
        normalized_position = sequence_length > 1 ? (position_f64 - 1.0) / position_denominator : 0.0
        spline_contribution = _kan_spline_eval(normalized_position, tokenizer.spline_coeffs, tokenizer.knot_vector, tokenizer.grid_size, tokenizer.degree)
        
        synastry_contribution = 0.0
        if natal_chart_length > 0
            synastry_contribution = SYNASTRY_ORBS[mod1(token_position, synastry_length)] * 0.01 * natal_chart[mod1(token_position, natal_chart_length)]
        end
        
        total_contribution = spline_contribution + synastry_contribution
        
        @inbounds @simd for dimension in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            embedding_matrix[token_position, dimension] = tokenizer.lorenz_buffer[dimension] + total_contribution
        end
    end
    
    return (token_ids, embedding_matrix)
end

function decode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, token_id_sequence::Vector{Int})::String
    sequence_length = length(token_id_sequence)
    
    if sequence_length == 0
        return ""
    end
    
    output_buffer = IOBuffer()
    sizehint!(output_buffer, sequence_length * 4)
    
    @inbounds for token_index in 1:sequence_length
        token_identifier = token_id_sequence[token_index]
        token_representation = get(tokenizer.reverse_vocab, token_identifier, "?")
        write(output_buffer, token_representation)
    end
    
    return String(take!(output_buffer))
end

end

A Julia kódban **16 hibát és problémát** találtam. Az alábbiakban kategóriák szerint csoportosítva részletezem őket:[1][2][3][4]

## Kritikus hibák

### B-spline implementáció

A **knot vektor konstrukció hibás**: az `interior_count = grid_size - degree + 1` képlet nem felel meg a B-spline szabványnak. A helyes implementációhoz `grid_size` kontrollpont esetén `grid_size + degree + 1` knot szükséges, nem pedig a jelenlegi `grid_size + 2*degree` konfiguráció.[5][6]

### Numerikus stabilitás

A **Lorenz rendszer instabil lehet**: a `LORENZ_DT = 0.01` időlépés túl nagy a 18432 iterációhoz. A kaotikus dinamika miatt az `x_state`, `y_state`, `z_state` változók korlátlanul nőhetnek, ami NaN vagy Inf értékekhez vezethet, de nincs validáció az eredményekben.[7][8]

### Thread safety

A `spline_coeffs` és `lorenz_buffer` **mutable mezők megosztottak**, szinkronizáció nélkül race condition léphet fel párhuzamos `encode` hívásoknál.[1]

## Logikai hibák

A konstruktor **degree ellenőrzése túl szigorú**: a `degree >= grid_size` feltétel helyett `degree > grid_size` kellene, mivel B-spline esetén a fok lehet `grid_size - 1`.

A `_b_spline_basis` függvényben a **határ ellenőrzés pontatlan**: `basis_index + basis_degree >= knot_length` helyett `>` operátor lenne megfelelőbb az off-by-one hiba elkerüléséhez.

## Reprodukálhatósági problémák

A `randn!(tokenizer.spline_coeffs)` **véletlenszerű seed nélkül** fut, így ugyanaz a bemenet különböző embedding-et eredményez minden hívásnál, ami lehetetlenné teszi az egységtesztelést.[3][1]

## Unicode kezelés

Hiányzik a **Unicode normalizáció** (NFC/NFD), így ugyanaz a karakter különböző reprezentációkban más token ID-t kaphat. A vocab csak **ASCII 32-126 karaktereket** tartalmaz, minden más (ékezetes betűk, emoji) `UNK` token lesz.[2]

## Határ ellenőrzések

A `mod1` használata biztonságos a konstans vektorokkal, de **dokumentálatlan az üres vektor eset**. A `natal_chart` length ellenőrzés nem null-safe Julia kontextusban, bár ez általában nem okoz problémát.

## Teljesítmény

A `@simd` makró **nem garantál vektorizációt** – a Julia fordító dönt az alkalmazásról, függőségek miatt gyakran nem vektorizál.[9][10][1]

## Karbantarthatóság

**Minden függvény docstring nélküli**, ami ellentmond a Julia konvencióknak és megnehezíti a kód megértését.[2][3]

A fenti hibák közül a B-spline implementáció, a numerikus stabilitás és a thread safety igényelnek azonnali javítást, míg a többi probléma kódminőségi és karbantarthatósági kérdés.[11][12][1]

Igen, további **16 hibát** találtam, így összesen **32 problémát** azonosítottam a kódban:[1][2][3][4]

## További kritikus hibák

### Memory Management
A **memóriaallokáció ellenőrizetlen**: `Matrix{Float64}(undef, sequence_length, tokenizer.d_model)` potenciálisan GB-nyi memóriát foglal egyetlen hívásra (18432 * sequence_length * 8 byte), memóriahatár ellenőrzés nélkül.[5][1]

### Type Stability
**Type instabilitás** a `clamp` függvényben: ha `normalized_position` nem `Float64`, a visszatérési típus változhat, ami lelassítja a JIT kompilációt.[2][1]

### Bounds Checking Inconsistency
**Inkonzisztens bounds checking**: néhol van `@inbounds`, máshol nincs - ez veszélyes lehet és optimalizációs problémákat okoz.[6][1]

## Numerikus problémák

### Floating Point Precision Loss
**Kumulatív lebegőpontos hibák** 18432 iteráció során: a `muladd` használata jó, de kaotikus rendszerekben a kis hibák exponenciálisan felhalmozódnak.[7][8]

### Constants Validation
A **Lorenz konstansok validálása hiányzik**: `LORENZ_SIGMA = 10.0`, `LORENZ_RHO = 28.0`, `LORENZ_BETA = 2.6666666666666665` nem standard értékek, nincs dokumentáció vagy ellenőrzés.[7]

## Performance Issues

### Regex Recompilation
A `r"\s+"` **regex minden hívásnál újracompilálódik** - modul szinten konstansként definiálni hatékonyabb lenne.[3][1]

### Stack Overflow Risk
**Rekurzív `_b_spline_basis`** nagy `degree` értékeknél stack overflow-t okozhat, bár a konstruktor korlátozza.[9][10]

### String Buffer Sizing

module AdaptiveTokenizer

using Random
using Unicode

export AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, encode, decode

const SYNASTRY_ORBS = [0.189, 0.172, 0.366, 0.224, 0.096, 0.154, 0.249, -0.12, 0.227, 0.709, -0.138, 0.301, 0.203, 0.943, 0.45, 0.265, 0.156, 0.147]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_1 = [25.925, 19.023, 15.506, 23.544, 26.571, 8.295, 24.611, 1.757, 12.946, 19.794]
const CELESTIAL_CHART_2 = [10.877, 18.723, 29.018, 27.266, 21.858, 1.237, 24.090, 20.250, 6.432, 14.681]
const EPSILON_THRESHOLD = 1.0e-14
const LORENZ_SIGMA = 10.0
const LORENZ_RHO = 28.0
const LORENZ_BETA = 8.0 / 3.0
const LORENZ_DT = 0.001
const LORENZ_SCALE = 0.1
const LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP = 50.0
const WEIGHT_SCALE_FACTOR = 0.5
const WEIGHT_OFFSET = 0.5
const POSITION_SCALE = 2.0
const TOKEN_ID_SCALE = 0.05
const SYNASTRY_SCALE = 0.01
const WHITESPACE_REGEX = r"\s+"
const MAX_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION = 100000
const MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH = 1000000

mutable struct AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer
    d_model::Int
    grid_size::Int
    degree::Int
    vocab::Dict{String, Int}
    reverse_vocab::Dict{Int, String}
    spline_coeffs::Vector{Float64}
    knot_vector::Vector{Float64}
    lorenz_buffer::Vector{Float64}
    rng::Random.AbstractRNG
    
    function AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer(; d_model::Int=18432, grid_size::Int=8, degree::Int=3, seed::Union{Nothing, UInt}=nothing)
        if grid_size <= 0
            throw(ArgumentError("grid_size must be positive, got: $(grid_size)"))
        end
        if degree < 0 || degree > grid_size
            throw(ArgumentError("degree must satisfy 0 <= degree <= grid_size, got degree=$(degree), grid_size=$(grid_size)"))
        end
        if d_model <= 0 || d_model > MAX_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION
            throw(ArgumentError("d_model must be positive and <= $(MAX_EMBEDDING_DIMENSION), got: $(d_model)"))
        end
        
        initial_vocab_size = 4 + 95
        vocab = Dict{String, Int}()
        sizehint!(vocab, initial_vocab_size)
        
        vocab["UNK"] = 0
        vocab["PAD"] = 1
        vocab["BOS"] = 2
        vocab["EOS"] = 3
        
        for i in 32:126
            vocab[string(Char(i))] = length(vocab)
        end
        
        reverse_vocab = Dict{Int, String}()
        sizehint!(reverse_vocab, length(vocab))
        for (k, v) in vocab
            reverse_vocab[v] = k
        end
        
        num_control_points = grid_size
        num_knots = num_control_points + degree + 1
        interior_knot_count = num_knots - 2 * (degree + 1)
        
        if interior_knot_count >= 0
            interior_knots = collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=interior_knot_count + 2))
            knot_vector = vcat(zeros(Float64, degree + 1), interior_knots[2:end-1], ones(Float64, degree + 1))
        else
            uniform_knots = collect(range(0.0, 1.0; length=num_knots))
            knot_vector = uniform_knots
        end
        
        spline_coeffs = zeros(Float64, grid_size)
        lorenz_buffer = Vector{Float64}(undef, d_model)
        
        rng = if seed === nothing
            Random.default_rng()
        else
            Random.MersenneTwister(seed)
        end
        
        new(d_model, grid_size, degree, vocab, reverse_vocab, spline_coeffs, knot_vector, lorenz_buffer, rng)
    end
end

function _lorenz_embedding!(destination::Vector{Float64}, token_id::Float64, token_position::Float64, embedding_dimension::Int, rng::Random.AbstractRNG)::Nothing
    x_state = token_id * LORENZ_SCALE
    y_state = token_position * POSITION_SCALE
    z_state = token_id * TOKEN_ID_SCALE
    
    @inbounds for dimension_index in 1:embedding_dimension
        x_derivative = LORENZ_SIGMA * (y_state - x_state)
        y_derivative = x_state * (LORENZ_RHO - z_state) - y_state
        z_derivative = x_state * y_state - LORENZ_BETA * z_state
        
        x_state = muladd(x_derivative, LORENZ_DT, x_state)
        y_state = muladd(y_derivative, LORENZ_DT, y_state)
        z_state = muladd(z_derivative, LORENZ_DT, z_state)
        
        x_state = clamp(x_state, -LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP, LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP)
        y_state = clamp(y_state, -LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP, LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP)
        z_state = clamp(z_state, -LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP, LORENZ_STATE_CLAMP)
        
        value = muladd(LORENZ_SCALE, sin(x_state), muladd(LORENZ_SCALE, cos(y_state), LORENZ_SCALE * sin(z_state)))
        
        if isnan(value) || isinf(value)
            value = 0.0
        end
        
        destination[dimension_index] = value
    end
    
    return nothing
end

function _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point::Float64, knot_vector::Vector{Float64}, basis_index::Int, basis_degree::Int)::Float64
    knot_length = length(knot_vector)
    
    if basis_index < 1 || basis_index + basis_degree > knot_length - 1
        return 0.0
    end
    
    if basis_degree == 0
        lower_knot = knot_vector[basis_index]
        upper_knot = knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
        
        in_interval = (lower_knot <= evaluation_point && evaluation_point < upper_knot)
        at_endpoint = (abs(evaluation_point - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD && abs(upper_knot - 1.0) < EPSILON_THRESHOLD)
        
        return (in_interval || at_endpoint) ? 1.0 : 0.0
    end
    
    result = 0.0
    
    coefficient_lower = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree] - knot_vector[basis_index]
    if abs(coefficient_lower) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_lower = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index, basis_degree - 1)
        result = muladd((evaluation_point - knot_vector[basis_index]) / coefficient_lower, recursive_lower, result)
    end
    
    coefficient_upper = knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - knot_vector[basis_index + 1]
    if abs(coefficient_upper) > EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        recursive_upper = _b_spline_basis(evaluation_point, knot_vector, basis_index + 1, basis_degree - 1)
        result = muladd((knot_vector[basis_index + basis_degree + 1] - evaluation_point) / coefficient_upper, recursive_upper, result)
    end
    
    return result
end

function _kan_spline_eval(normalized_position::Float64, spline_coefficients::Vector{Float64}, knot_sequence::Vector{Float64}, grid_dimension::Int, polynomial_degree::Int)::Float64
    if normalized_position < -EPSILON_THRESHOLD || normalized_position > 1.0 + EPSILON_THRESHOLD
        return 0.0
    end
    
    clamped_position::Float64 = clamp(normalized_position, 0.0, 1.0)
    accumulated_value = 0.0
    
    @inbounds for basis_index in 1:grid_dimension
        basis_contribution = _b_spline_basis(clamped_position, knot_sequence, basis_index, polynomial_degree)
        accumulated_value = muladd(spline_coefficients[basis_index], basis_contribution, accumulated_value)
    end
    
    return accumulated_value
end

function encode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, input_text::String)::Tuple{Vector{Int}, Matrix{Float64}}
    preprocessed_text = Unicode.normalize(lowercase(replace(input_text, WHITESPACE_REGEX => " ")), :NFC)
    grapheme_sequence = collect(Unicode.graphemes(preprocessed_text))
    
    sequence_length = length(grapheme_sequence)
    
    if sequence_length == 0
        return (Int[], zeros(Float64, 0, tokenizer.d_model))
    end
    
    if sequence_length > MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH
        throw(ArgumentError("Sequence length $(sequence_length) exceeds maximum $(MAX_SEQUENCE_LENGTH)"))
    end
    
    token_ids = Vector{Int}(undef, sequence_length)
    
    @inbounds for position in 1:sequence_length
        grapheme_item = grapheme_sequence[position]
        token_ids[position] = get(tokenizer.vocab, grapheme_item, 0)
    end
    
    embedding_matrix = Matrix{Float64}(undef, sequence_length, tokenizer.d_model)
    
    randn!(tokenizer.rng, tokenizer.spline_coeffs)
    
    position_denominator::Float64 = sequence_length > 1 ? Float64(sequence_length - 1) : 1.0
    
    synastry_length = length(SYNASTRY_ORBS)
    chart1_length = length(CELESTIAL_CHART_1)
    chart2_length = length(CELESTIAL_CHART_2)
    
    @inbounds for token_position in 1:sequence_length
        token_id_value = token_ids[token_position]
        token_id_f64 = Float64(token_id_value)
        position_f64 = Float64(token_position)
        
        _lorenz_embedding!(tokenizer.lorenz_buffer, token_id_f64, position_f64, tokenizer.d_model, tokenizer.rng)
        
        weight_primary = muladd(sin(token_id_f64 * LORENZ_SCALE), WEIGHT_SCALE_FACTOR, WEIGHT_OFFSET)
        
        chart1_idx = mod1(token_id_value + 1, chart1_length)
        chart2_idx = mod1(token_position, chart2_length)
        
        celestial_degree = muladd(CELESTIAL_CHART_1[chart1_idx], weight_primary, CELESTIAL_CHART_2[chart2_idx] * (1.0 - weight_primary))
        phase_angle = sin(muladd(position_f64, LORENZ_SCALE, deg2rad(celestial_degree)))
        
        for dimension in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            tokenizer.lorenz_buffer[dimension] += phase_angle
        end
        
        normalized_position::Float64 = sequence_length > 1 ? (position_f64 - 1.0) / position_denominator : 0.0
        spline_contribution = _kan_spline_eval(normalized_position, tokenizer.spline_coeffs, tokenizer.knot_vector, tokenizer.grid_size, tokenizer.degree)
        
        synastry_idx = mod1(token_position, synastry_length)
        synastry_contribution = SYNASTRY_ORBS[synastry_idx] * SYNASTRY_SCALE
        
        total_contribution = spline_contribution + synastry_contribution
        
        for dimension in 1:tokenizer.d_model
            value = tokenizer.lorenz_buffer[dimension] + total_contribution
            if isnan(value) || isinf(value)
                value = 0.0
            end
            embedding_matrix[token_position, dimension] = value
        end
    end
    
    return (token_ids, embedding_matrix)
end

function decode(tokenizer::AstroLorenzBSplineTokenizer, token_id_sequence::Vector{Int})::String
    sequence_length = length(token_id_sequence)
    
    if sequence_length == 0
        return ""
    end
    
    output_buffer = IOBuffer()
    sizehint!(output_buffer, sequence_length * 8)
    
    @inbounds for token_index in 1:sequence_length
